title: WorkspacePlan v1
description: Declares how to materialize a session's working tree under /workspace/current at pod claim time. Nested under CreateSessionRequest.workspacePlan. See spec/14_workspace-plan-schema.md.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference per §14.1 line 313: clients MAY embed `$schema` on their workspacePlan object so local 2020-12 validators recognize the canonical example. The gateway ignores the field for routing decisions; it is preserved by round-trip.

schemaVersion.description: Wire-compat identifier. v1 ships with this value. Gateways reject schemaVersion > known with 422 WORKSPACE_PLAN_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.

sources.description: Ordered list of source directives. Later entries overwrite earlier paths (last-writer-wins). Unknown source.type values are skipped with a workspace_plan_unknown_source_type warning.

setupCommands.description: Commands to execute after sources materialize, before the agent session starts. Subject to setupCommandPolicy (allowlist by default).

modeFile.description: Unix file permission as an octal string. Setuid/setgid bits are rejected on all source types. Sticky bit is rejected on file types (inlineFile, uploadFile, uploadArchive).

modeDir.description: Unix directory permission as an octal string. Setuid/setgid bits are rejected. Sticky bit is permitted on directories.

content.description: UTF-8 text. Binary files must use uploadFile.

uploadRef.description: Reference to a previously uploaded blob (lenny-blob:// URI or upload id).

stripComponents.description: Leading path segments to drop per entry (GNU tar semantics). Entries with insufficient segments are skipped with a workspace_plan_strip_components_skip warning.

url.description: HTTPS only. SSH and git:// are rejected at schema validation.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Resolved to a commit SHA at session creation and stored in resolvedCommitSha.

depth.description: Shallow-clone depth. Omit for a full clone.

resolvedCommitSha.description: Gateway-written. Clients that supply this field are rejected with 400 WORKSPACE_PLAN_INVALID (reason: gateway_written_field).

cmd.description: Command to execute. Subject to setupCommandPolicy (allowlist by default).

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-command timeout. Default comes from the runtime's setupPolicy.timeoutSeconds.
